meta.note: Source of truth for CYA Design System values. Edit here, run npm run build, tag a release, then re-sync the design system page.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Primary teal. Brand fields, links, secondary button borders, focus ring, Kicker accents. Safe for text on white (7.4:1), warm white (6.9:1) and green grey (6.2:1).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Deep teal. All headings (h1 to h4), footers, deep sections. 10.1:1 on warm white. White text on it is 10.9:1.

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: Brighter teal. Selected energetic accents only: icons, data marks, rules. 3.65:1 on white, so never body text or small labels; large text (24px+) and icons only.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Signature gold. The primary CTA fill (white text, Glenn's brand decision, 9 Nov 2026) plus rules, dots, icon fills and the logo's linework. White text on it is 2.9:1, below WCAG AA: keep CTA labels short, 15px semibold or larger, and never use gold for text itself.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for gold CTAs. White text 4.7:1.

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Warm white. The page canvas on the website and the Studio side rail.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. Cards, forms, reading areas, alternate sections.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Charcoal. Body copy and UI text on light surfaces. 12.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: green-grey
tokens.usage: Green grey. Quiet panels, icon discs, hairline dividers. Decorative only as a border: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: pale-highlight
tokens.usage: Pale highlight. Small tips, notes, callout fills. Use sparingly; charcoal text 10.7:1.

tokens.name: charcoal-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text: charcoal at 75% on warm white, resolved to a solid hex. Captions, meta, helper text. 5.6:1 on warm white, 5.3:1 on green grey. Derived tint of charcoal, not a new hue.

tokens.name: charcoal-border
tokens.usage: Control border: charcoal at 55%. Input, select and checkbox edges, which need 3:1 (3.3:1 on white). Derived tint of charcoal.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on teal-deep: white at 80%. 7.6:1.

tokens.name: logo-teal
tokens.usage: Logo lens teal, as drawn in the approved mark. Logo artwork only, never UI.

tokens.name: logo-pale
tokens.usage: Logo pale disc, as drawn in the approved mark. Logo artwork only, never UI.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error. Validation messages and error borders, always with text. 6.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success. Confirmation messages, always with text. 5.1:1 on white. Carried from the Wellbeing Studio system; the website has no success colour yet.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Neutral near-black scrim for text over photography or video. Deliberately not teal so it does not colour-grade the image. Fade it with gradients toward transparent.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Default page background (website body, Studio side rail).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, reading panels, Studio main canvas.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: Quiet section tone (Section tone=mist), icon discs, inline notes.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Deep section tone (Section tone=teal), footer. Use one deep band per page at most; fewer teal blocks is the 2027 direction.

tokens.name: surface-highlight
tokens.usage: Tips and small callouts.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body text on any light surface.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings h1 to h4 on light surfaces.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, emphasised labels, Kicker on light surfaces.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines, helper text.

tokens.name: text-on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-deep and on scrim over photography.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes (3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Secondary button border, selected states.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill: signature gold.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary CTA hover and pressed.

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Text on action-primary. 2.9:1 on gold, an accepted brand trade-off; see Audit.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px solid outline, 4px offset, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: accent-rule
tokens.usage: Gold rules, dots and small decorative marks.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statements only, one per page. Fluid: clamp(3rem, 1.9rem + 4.8vw, 6rem), so 48px on mobile to 96px.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: h3, card group headings, Studio page titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: h4, card titles, list row titles.

styles.name: studio-wordmark
styles.usage: Typeset name of Wellbeing Studio until a drawn wordmark exists. Never improvise a logo around it.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Simple, credible practices that help people feel and work better.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and section leads (text-lg leading-relaxed).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sessions run on site, by livestream or in Wellbeing Studio.
styles.usage: Default body copy. Measure 55 to 75 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We reply within two business days.
styles.usage: Card body, form helper text, list detail.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow above headings. Uppercase via CSS; write the source text in sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Photographed at a client workplace, Brisbane.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: kicker to heading, label to input (6px in code rounds here).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, checkbox row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Container gutter on mobile (px-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Container gutter at sm (px-8), form block padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile (py-10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Container gutter at lg (px-12), primary block gaps.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section padding at sm (py-14).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding at lg (py-16).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero and feature band padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Largest editorial pause between major bands.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Editorial panels, full-bleed bands and photography on the website.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Website default: inputs, cards, error summary, focus outline corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: All buttons and CTAs, across every product (Glenn, 9 Nov 2026). Also Wellbeing Studio raised surfaces and media tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, status chips and the Studio Save toggle only. Never CTAs.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Website default. Hierarchy comes from type, rules and photography, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Wellbeing Studio menus, popovers and dialogs only.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Content width for every page.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Typographic-only moments and long-form Insights articles.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header at sm and up (80px on mobile).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs (min-h-12). 44px absolute floor for nav items.
